stem: Which statement explains the significance of this colonial institution?

options.label: A
options.text: The assembly served as a model for other colonial legislatures.

options.label: B
options.text: Colonists used the assembly to overrule decisions of the royal governor.

options.label: C
options.text: The assembly sent delegates to Parliament to represent Virginia.

options.label: D
options.text: The king revoked Virginia's charter because the assembly became too powerful.

visual_elements: Diagram with 'Virginia House of Burgesses' at center top with arrows pointing to three boxes: 'Held its first meeting in 1619', 'Had the power to make laws for the colony', 'Was the first colonial assembly of elected representatives'.
